text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When a program does not work correctly, the first step is identifying bugs by observing the wrong behaviour and understanding what the code should do instead. Good debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you find exactly where the problem happens. It is also wise to follow a systematic approach: change one thing at a time and test again, so you always know what caused the fix. Finally, logging is extremely useful. Adding log messages to your code shows what the program is doing at each stage, which makes it much easier to spot errors and solve them quickly.
